name: Business insurance renewal review
summary: Before the business insurance renews, the owner gets one pack: every policy with insurer, limits, deductibles, premium and dates; renewal terms beside expiring ones, every change marked; what changed in the business; claims; and questions for the broker. The broker and the owner decide all cover.

sources.title: The renewal pack's form, the item-by-item marking of every change between the expiring schedules and the renewal terms, the dates counted from the renewal date, the questions for the broker that each rest on a fact, and the rules that no policy wording is interpreted and no cover recommended, written for this template.

sources.contribution: A single list of every policy before renewal; the business's revenue, payroll, vehicles and sites weighed against what is insured; the amounts of cover customer contracts call for; claims totalled by type of cover and squared with the business's own records; each figure checked against the current documents.

Customers who want a named amount of cover and to be named on the policy; keeping what the insurer is told about the business up to date; reading a policy's exclusions alongside its cost; a fresh look at cover as the business grows.
